strategy.summary: PR #130 adds coupon codes (src/coupons.js: SAVE10 10% off rounded down, TENOFF £10 off capped at the total, codes matched case-insensitively and trimmed, unknown codes throw UnknownCouponError), a bulk discount (src/pricing.js: 10% off at 10+ items, the larger of bulk and spend discounts) and a coupon option on priceBasket applied after the discount. The existing tests only cover the spend discount and a coupon-less basket, so the tests must prove each new rule. The formatPence change is a refactor already covered by test/format.test.js.
inScope: src/pricing.js bulk discount in discountFor and coupon option of priceBasket
outOfScope: src/format.js: refactor with unchanged output, already asserted by test/format.test.js (pounds/pence, padding, minus sign)
Behaviour the PR did not change (spend discount, cart line totals)
assumptions: Code is the source of truth: couponDiscount also trims spaces around a code (the PR description only mentions case); tests cover both as the code's docstring says.
Because bulk (10%) and spend (5%) apply to the same subtotal, bulk always wins once it applies; 'when that's more' is shown by a basket qualifying for both.

acceptanceCriteria.text: SAVE10 takes 10% off the total, rounded down to whole pence
TENOFF takes 1000p off, never more than the total (never below zero)
A coupon code is matched whatever its case (and surrounding spaces)
An unknown coupon code is refused with an UnknownCouponError
A coupon comes off after the spend/bulk discount, and priceBasket reports what it took
Baskets of 10 or more items (counted across lines) get 10% off; fewer than 10 get no bulk discount
When both the bulk and spend discounts apply, the larger one is given (not both)

review.standard: Reuse the repo's helpers… and match its naming, layout and import style; Vitest: wrap the call so the matcher can catch the throw (expect(() => fn()).toThrow(Type))
review.summary: The changes capture errors with a hand-written try/catch twice, as the `thrownBy` helper here and again inline at test/pricing.test.js:62-67, where the repo's own tests (test/cart.test.js:10) and the Vitest standard use `expect(() => …).toThrow(ErrorClass)`.
review.failureScenario: Nothing passes wrongly today: if the call stops throwing, `error` is undefined and `toBeInstanceOf` fails. But the same error-capture code now exists in two different forms in two files, and neither follows the repo's convention. A future test that copies the inline form and drops the instanceof check would pass when nothing is thrown. Use `expect(() => couponDiscount('SAVE20', 5000)).toThrow(UnknownCouponError)` plus `.toThrow('"SAVE20"')` (and the same for 'NOPE' in pricing.test.js), or keep one shared helper. Don't do both.
